steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Halve and deseed 2 red bell peppers, then place them cut side down on the prepared sheet.
Roast the red bell peppers for 20 minutes, until the skins are blistered and soft.
Meanwhile, rinse 180 g of quinoa and combine it with 360 ml of vegetable broth in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed.
Warm 30 ml of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add 400 g of cooked chickpeas, cumin, and turmeric.
Cook the chickpeas for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly golden.
Add 60 g of spinach and 60 ml of water to the skillet; cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Peel and roughly chop the roasted red bell peppers, then stir them into the chickpea mixture with 15 ml of lemon juice.
Divide the quinoa among bowls, spoon the chickpea mixture on top, and serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.
